blocks.text: Vibrant Custom Vehicle Decals for a Pontiac Trans Am

blocks.html:
Our team worked on custom decals for a client’s Pontiac Trans Am. The rich gold decals perfectly complement the black vehicle. Check out more details on this stunning transformation below!

Custom Vehicle Decals Project Insights

A big thank you to the designers at Branding Centres for their work on the installation!

This project utilized Wrap Authority’s design, printed on a 1080 Series IJ 180 Gloss Finish Printable Vinyl.
